basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old gamer from Austin, Texas, just getting into the world of Escape from Tarkov and online gaming communities. By day, I work as a junior IT support specialist at a local tech firm, and by night, I'm exploring the virtual battlegrounds. I'm not a fan of bugs and glitches in games, especially when they cause such heavy losses! My typical online hours are evenings and weekends, as I juggle my early career and a budding interest in gaming. I'm currently single, giving me plenty of time to immerse myself in these new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to Reddit and gaming, my knowledge is growing. I have a foundational understanding of IT from my job, which helps me troubleshoot basic tech issues. My gaming knowledge is mostly from YouTube tutorials and gaming forums. I'm still learning the ins and outs of the Tarkov community.
